name: Gabe Paladin
bio: Bronwyn's older brother. JD's actual friend — not just a proximity arrangement. They connected through drone visits, the 2017 Chitty Chitty Bang Bang musical, and Monday-night youth group. The friendship ended without closure in August 2018. JD has noted this as an unacknowledged piece of damage in the record.
public_footprint:
College Ministry Pastor at Christian Fellowship Center (CFC) in Potsdam, NY. Worship music artist who recorded a live album at his home church in New York in January 2026 and has releases on streaming platforms, including 'What Can I Give (Live)'. Also left a public testimonial for a portrait session with JD Meyers Productions.
